SF-63
SFI - ENGINE COOLANT TEMPERATURE {ECl) SENSOR
INSPECTION
1. DRAIN ENGINE COOLANT
2. REMOVE N0.2 CYLINDER HEAD COVER
3. REMOVE ECT SENSOR
4. INSPECT ECT SENSOR RESISTANCE1£ Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between terminals
1 (E2) and 2 (THW),
Ohmmeter Resistance: Refer to the graph¤ If the resistance is not as specified, replace the ECT sensor. [OJ 5. REINSTALL ECT SENSOR
Install a new gasket to the ECT sensor.
6. REINSTALL N0.2 CYLINDER HEAD COVER
7. FILL RADIATOR WITH ENGINE COOLANT
Acceptable
